description: Editorial hero with content anchored to the corners of the viewport (headline bottom-left, description right, CTA bottom-right), tall scroll spacers between sections, a 3-column offset feature grid, and a glassmorphism footer. Cinematic, premium, sporty/luxury feel.
prompt_template:
LAYOUT SKELETON — structure and motion only. All names, copy, fonts, and colors come from the Build Brief above; this skeleton contains none.

PAGE STRUCTURE (App.tsx):
<ScrollFrames /> first, then a fixed header, then <main className="relative z-10"> containing: Hero (100vh) → Spacer (150-200vh) → Feature section → Spacer (150-200vh) → Footer.

FIXED HEADER: logo/wordmark left; 4-5 small uppercase tracking-widest nav links right; one small pill CTA. Transparent background, no border. Nav links smooth-scroll to section ids.

HERO (h-screen, w-[90%] mx-auto, flex column): a 12-column grid on desktop. Oversized display headline (clamp, 2 lines, tight leading) anchored bottom-left spanning ~7 columns; a short description paragraph mid-right (~4 columns, small text, 60% opacity); a two-part pill CTA bottom-right (label segment + arrow segment with a 1px gap). Elements fade-up in with a small stagger on load.

SPACERS: <div className="h-[175vh] pointer-events-none" /> between sections — these give the background video room to scrub. Keep them empty.

FEATURE SECTION (min-h-screen, centered content, max-w-6xl): an eyebrow label (numbered, e.g. 01), one large statement heading that reveals word-by-word on scroll (Framer Motion whileInView with staggered spans), then a 3-column grid where the middle column is offset vertically (translate-y) for asymmetry. Each cell: thin 1px top border, small numbered label, short title, 2-line description. No card backgrounds — transparent with borders only.

FOOTER (final section, sits at the absolute bottom of the scroll): a large glassmorphism panel (backdrop-blur, translucent dark fill, rounded top corners) containing a big CTA headline + pill button, a 4-column link grid, and a thin copyright bar with a 1px top border.

MOTION: Framer Motion only. Fade/slide whileInView reveals, hover states on nav (label slides up, duplicate slides in from below). Nothing bouncy.

description: A fixed oversized typographic overlay that collapses character-by-character as you scroll, a centered floating pill navigation, and a large glass panel that slides up from the bottom with a brand marquee. Artistic, fashion/creative-studio energy.
prompt_template:
LAYOUT SKELETON — structure and motion only. All names, copy, fonts, and colors come from the Build Brief above; this skeleton contains none.

PAGE STRUCTURE (App.tsx):
<ScrollFrames /> first, then <PillNav /> (fixed), then a relative container ~350vh tall containing <FloatingHeadline /> (fixed overlay) and <GlassPanel /> (absolute bottom-0), then a slim footer section.

PILL NAV (fixed, centered horizontally, top-6, z-50): a circular logo pill (48px, solid fill, simple inline-SVG glyph) + an adjacent rounded pill bar with 3-4 nav items (uppercase, 13-14px, tracked). Each item is its own small pill; on hover the label slides up and a duplicate label in inverted colors slides in from below (Framer Motion). Entry: logo scales in with a spring, items fade in with slight delay. On mobile collapse items into a hamburger with a small dropdown. Nav items smooth-scroll (element.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})) — no scroll libraries.

FLOATING HEADLINE: fixed inset-0, flex column justify-end, p-4 md:p-8, pointer-events-none, z-10. Two lines of display text at clamp(4rem, 15vw, 18rem), line-height 0.85. Wrap each character in an inline-block span; drive a per-character exit animation from scroll position (useScroll + useTransform, or a scroll-linked variants stagger): characters translate down, squash slightly (scaleY up / scaleX down) and fade as the user scrolls the first ~600px.

GLASS PANEL (absolute bottom-0 of the 350vh container): a max-w-6xl h-[85vh] max-h-[900px] rounded-3xl panel — translucent dark fill, heavy backdrop-blur, 1px white/10 border. It slides up from below the viewport tied to scroll progress (y: 100% → 0% via useScroll on the container). Optional gentle mouse-parallax tilt (a few px translate + 2-3deg rotate, spring-smoothed). Inside, centered: a small italic eyebrow, one very large serif-or-display statement heading (a few words italicized or accented), and at the bottom a full-width marquee strip (uppercase names separated by generous padding, translateX loop at ~20s, 40% opacity, 1px top border).

FOOTER (after the container): minimal single-row footer — wordmark left, 3-4 links right, thin top border, transparent background.

MOTION: Framer Motion only (useScroll, useTransform, springs). No GSAP, no scroll libraries, no manual rAF loops.
